scenarios.title: Investigate creates a Clue token
decisions: A casts Thraben Inspector, tapping Plains.
B passes priority; both players pass and Thraben Inspector resolves and enters the battlefield.
The enters trigger goes on the stack, both players pass, and it resolves (investigate).

variants.label: resolves
variants.expected: Thraben Inspector is on the battlefield under A's control. A controls one new Clue token, a colorless artifact.

variants.label: countered
variants.delta: B casts Counterspell on Thraben Inspector, tapping both Islands.
variants.expected: Thraben Inspector is countered and moves to A's graveyard without entering the battlefield. No enters trigger fires and A controls no Clue token.
